sourceReview.reason: This recycles the early-October milestone that BNB Chain hosted about $1.1 billion of a $3.7 billion tokenized-stock and ETF market. RWA Wire already covers the same market-size event, and the lead adds no separate launch, approval, financing or material expansion.
